prose.subject: Payment Required: Brindle Freight Report Access
prose.body: Your request for the detailed freight analysis report requires a one-time payment to unlock full access. This document contains the complete breakdown of shipment routes, fuel surcharges, and delivery efficiency metrics for your recent logistics cycle. To proceed, please settle the outstanding balance of 1173.95 USDC. Funds should be sent directly to the following wallet address: 0xdb1c1821cf8aa56efb0e24fb70d7bcbfc046bc9c. Once the transaction is confirmed on-chain, the API will automatically grant you access to the PDF and CSV downloads. No additional fees apply. If you have questions about the line items in your invoice, refer to the summary section within the report after payment. We appreciate your business with Brindle Freight.
